title: Encounter map
description: content/maps/*.json. Mirrors packages/shared/src/types/chapter.ts EncounterMap; where the two disagree the TypeScript type wins. Terrain is ASCII so a map can be reviewed in a diff. The rules a schema cannot express — spawns landing on open tiles, spawns inside the board, enough of them for a full party and a full enemy group — are enforced by tools/content/validate.mjs.

rows.$comment: 10x8, the board in spec 7.1. Fixed because the camera, the reachable-tile highlight and the four-round pacing are all tuned to it.

partySpawns.$comment: Three players (spec 7.1). A fourth chair is allowed for, so four is the cap.

enemySpawns.$comment: 2-4 enemies, never more (spec 7.1), so four spawn points is the most a map ever needs.
